subject.title: feat(openrouter): forward OpenClaw session id as session_id

question: Should OpenClaw expose `plugins.entries.openrouter.config.forwardSessionId` as the supported default-off contract for sending a stable opaque session key to OpenRouter, rather than rely on or extend generic session-affinity configuration?
rationale: This is a new persisted configuration and external identifier-egress surface; code review can establish that the implementation is narrow, but cannot choose the permanent public configuration boundary or privacy policy.

options.title: Adopt the plugin-local opaque option
options.body: Keep the OpenRouter-only, default-off boolean and require refreshed live proof for the digest value before merge.

options.title: Use an existing generic affinity surface
options.body: Close or rework the branch toward the established provider compatibility path if maintainers want one shared session-affinity contract instead of an OpenRouter-specific setting.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause the PR until a broader provider-context and identifier-egress policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt the plugin-local opaque option
recommendation.body: Keep the OpenRouter-only, default-off boolean and require refreshed live proof for the digest value before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes the initial contract discussion to steipete, making them the best available decision owner from the provided evidence.
